        IsIntegral.{0, 0} Int (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (Finset.sum.{0, 0} Finset.univ.{0} fun i => ε i) (Nat.cast.{0} n)) →
          Or (∀ (i j : Fin n), Eq.{1} (ε i) (ε j)) (Eq.{1} (Finset.sum.{0, 0} Finset.univ.{0} fun i => ε i) 0)
